state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What is the daily meal allowance for an intern on a client-site day in Paris today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: relocation lump sum a regular employee relocating at the company's request
state.step_intent: Find the relocation lump sum that applies to: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)?

passages.source: HB-01 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-02-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-16
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 3250 EUR. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

passages.source: HB-16 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-01
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 2500 EUR. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.source: HB-16 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-01
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 1000 EUR is added to the standard relocation lump sum. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

passages.source: HB-01 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-02-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-16
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 1000 EUR was added to the standard relocation lump sum. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-30 §5 | Policy FAQ — Current relocation lump sum | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard relocation lump sum? A: 2500 EUR, as set in HB-16 §2 (effective 2026-06-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-37.
